artifacts.angle: Expose how treating tax refunds, work bonuses, or cash gifts differently than normal salary causes people to waste thousands. Show how a $2,000 tax refund gets treated like 'free money' and spent on impulse trips instead of debt. The counter-move: automated single-bucket routing where all incoming funds hit the exact same high-yield buffer account.
artifacts.hook: Why do we spend a tax refund three times faster than our regular paycheck?
artifacts.title: Why You Waste Tax Refunds (And How to Stop)
